planted.what: The TTL went from 5 s to 60 s on 2026-04-14 as the mitigation for INC-212. Dashboard views read about 40 profiles each, one query per member, and saturated the profile DB.
planted.quote: PROFILE_TTL was raised from 5 to 60 as an emergency mitigation for INC-212, not as a freshness choice.

planted.what: The reason has expired. On 2026-07-30 the dashboard switched to profile.get_many, one query per view instead of about 40, which was INC-212's own follow-up. The load the 60 s TTL protected against is gone, so lowering it is open again (subject to a measurement).
planted.quote: So the reason has probably expired, but nothing in the repo measures whether 5 s is now safe.

traps.what: Saying no reason is recorded (there is one: the commit and INC-212), or that the 2026-04 reason still holds as written. The batching commit removed the 40-reads-per-view load.
